C.quote: An Israeli airstrike also killed paramedic Ali Shahrour and wounded two others when it hit an ambulance in Kfar Rumman, according to Lebanon-based Al Mayadeen television [src-021].
C.input_contradiction: src-021 reports the killing of paramedic Ali Shahrour as Anadolu Agency's own reporting; Al Mayadeen is cited in that source only for the separate assertion that the Israeli military directly targeted the moving vehicle. The INPUT does not attribute the casualty fact itself to Al Mayadeen.

C.quote: Migrants and minorities in Saxony-Anhalt described fear and hostility following the result.
C.input_contradiction: The two sources this paragraph rests on are pre-election: src-046 is summarised as documenting anxiety 'ahead of the vote', src-045 carries an estimated date of 2026-08-30 (the election is 2026-09-06), and actor-054's position in src-046 is conditional ('if the AfD comes to power the atmosphere will be poisoned'). The INPUT does not place these statements after the result.

C.quote: If no minister-president is elected within a set number of ballots, the state constitution provides for new elections [src-023].
C.input_contradiction: src-023 is summarised only as explaining 'the constitutional procedure if no minister-president is elected'. Neither a number of ballots nor a constitutional provision for new elections appears anywhere in the INPUT; Siegmund's separate statement that new elections may be held is a political threat, not a constitutional rule.

C.quote: Migrants and minorities in Saxony-Anhalt described fear and hostility following the result.

C.quote: The strikes resumed hours after US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner completed their first-ever visit to Kyiv, where they urged both Russia and Ukraine to make compromises [src-006][src-003].
C.input_contradiction: The INPUT dates the envoys' Kyiv visit to 6 September (src-006, src-009, src-017, all estimated_date 2026-09-06) and the resumed strikes to the early hours of 8 September (src-001, src-012, src-018), with src-002 stating the three-day pause expired on Monday evening. Nothing in the INPUT supports the strikes following the completed Kyiv visit by hours rather than by roughly two days.

C.quote: Poland's Operational Command scrambled fighter jets and activated air-defence systems in response to Russian long-range aviation operating near Polish airspace [src-040][src-008].
C.input_contradiction: The INPUT (actor-075, src-040) states that Polish military aviation began operating in Polish airspace 'because of Russian long-range strikes on Ukraine' — the Russian aviation is described as striking Ukrainian territory. No part of the INPUT states that Russian long-range aviation was operating near Polish airspace.

C.quote: The National News Agency reported a higher toll of 11 to 12 killed, including two infants, after a strike on a three-storey residential building and a separate drone attack on a vehicle that killed a paramedic [src-001][src-003][src-005].
C.input_contradiction: Only src-001 carries an NNA-sourced count (11, including two infants). src-003 attributes the figure of 12 killed and 10 wounded in Kfar Roummane to the Lebanese Health Ministry, and src-005 likewise attributes 12 killed to the Health Ministry; no INPUT source attributes a count of 12 to the National News Agency.

C.quote: Israel has issued new evacuation orders for Deir Ez-Zahrani and surrounding areas [src-014][src-028], while the Lebanese Health Ministry's cumulative toll continues to rise across all fronts [src-004][src-029].
C.input_contradiction: src-004 is an Anadolu report on Gaza citing Gaza's Health Ministry (1,344 ceasefire-violation deaths, more than 73,000 overall), not the Lebanese Health Ministry; src-029 gives the Lebanese ministry's Lebanon-only figure of 4,362 killed and 12,378 wounded. No INPUT source has the Lebanese Health Ministry counting a toll 'across all fronts'.

C.quote: Israel has issued new evacuation orders for Deir Ez-Zahrani and surrounding areas [src-014][src-028], while the Lebanese Health Ministry's cumulative toll continues to rise across all fronts [src-004][src-029].
